hypothesis_or_artifact: REGISTRATION.md Section 9, the registered restart floor and its touch-probability justification
label: DERIVED
claim_quote: The floor is 500 USD of total account equity, a 400 USD loss on 900 deployed after the 100 buffer, 1.31 sigma of the width-20 tracking error, driftless touch probability near 19 percent in year one.
evidence_summary: σ used throughout Section 9 and ADR-011 is 900 USD × TE(20). TE(20) = 42.544 %/yr from the two-point power law (REGISTRATION.md:117; exponent reproduced as −0.32111 from the recorded widths 5 and 50), giving σ = **382.90 USD** (900 × the rounded 42.54 % gives 382.86; the difference is immaterial to every figure below). A **400 USD** loss is 400/382.90 = **1.045 σ**, touch 2Φ(−1.045) = **29.6 %** — not 1.31 σ and not 19 %. The stated 1.31 σ and 19 % require a **500 USD** loss: 500/382.90 = **1.306 σ**, 2Φ(−1.306) = **19.16 %**. That is exactly (1000 total equity − 500 floor), the basis ADR-011 uses for all three of its numbers. ADR-011 is internally consistent on that basis and never states a loss figure: "600 is 1.04 sigma … near 30 percent … 500 is 1.31 sigma, near 19 percent. 400 is 1.57 sigma, near 12 percent" (HFExperiment/DECISIONS.md:173-179). I reproduce 1.045 σ / 29.6 %, 1.306 σ / 19.16 %, 1.567 σ / 11.71 %, and the "7 more points" of REGISTRATION.md:220-221 as 19.16 − 11.71 = 7.4. n = 0 observations; these are design projections. Under the alternative reading — that the 100 buffer is consumed first, so the sleeve starts at 900 and 900 → 500 is a 400 loss — the touch probability would be 29.6 %, again not the 19 % stated in the same sentence. **Neither reading makes all three of (400 loss, 1.31 σ, 19 %) true.**
recomputation: inputs TE(20) = 42.544 %/yr (from the fit at DECISIONS.md:143-147, tabulated at REGISTRATION.md:117), deployed 900 USD (REGISTRATION.md:133). Method: σ = 900 × TE; k = loss/σ; touch = 2Φ(−k) with `scipy.stats.norm`. Tolerance 0.01 σ and 0.5 percentage points. Re-executed independently at consolidation: 1.0447 / 29.62 %, 1.3058 / 19.16 %, 1.5670 / 11.71 %.
would_resolve: replacing "a 400 USD loss on 900 deployed after the 100 buffer" with "a 500 USD loss of total equity, leaving 400 in the sleeve", which is what the 1.31 σ and the 19 % already encode. Nothing else in Section 9 or ADR-011 moves.
confidence_why: HIGH on the arithmetic — the three figures cannot be simultaneously true under either reading. MEDIUM on materiality: this most likely reads as "down to 400" rather than "a 400 loss", and the operative registered number (500) and its justification are correct.
invalidation_note: closed repository, HEAD is the anchored SHA, and REGISTRATION.md is append-only with the Section 9 text landed at `a8f4b0d` and never edited.
disclosure_ref: no for the arithmetic. The authors *do* disclose the surrounding modelling limits at REGISTRATION.md:222-224 ("The figures ignore market beta, which the high-beta book makes optimistic, and ignore positive drift"), and ADR-011 offers "a measured book beta would refine the touch probabilities" (DECISIONS.md:188) — neither touches the loss figure.
